name: Ariwara no Narihira
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 17); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 825–880.

poems.title: All red with leaves Tatsuta’s stream
poems.author: Ariwara no Narihira
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 17
poems.text:
All red with leaves Tatsuta’s stream
So softly purls along,
The everlasting Gods themselves,
Who judge ’twixt right and wrong,
Ne’er heard so sweet a song.
